rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=9, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_filter_init_std=0.05, vn_rbf_init_std=0.01, vn_lambda_init=0.02, epochs=20, batch_size=2, lr=0.00096, grad_clip=0.1, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=43, max_train_s=1500, rationale=iter-15 (six-box). iter-14 (champion config, seed=43) DIVERGED: RMSE=2.19e6, PSNR=-136, SSIM=0.18 -> the unrolled VN exploded (NaN/inf) at seed=43 despite grad_clip=1.0. FAILURE MODE: numerical divergence / VN-family instability -- the champion sits near an instability edge at grad_clip=1.0 and is seed-fragile. This is a STABILITY problem, not a config-quality problem. ONE KNOB vs iter-14: grad_clip 1.0 -> 0.1 (10x tighter gradient clipping to prevent the explosion). Keep seed=43 to still obtain the replicate. HYPOTHESIS: tighter clipping prevents the seed=43 divergence and yields a STABLE hr~0.63 replicate, confirming champion robustness once the training is stabilized; also a generally safer training recipe. All else = iter-6 champion (T=5,f=16,k=9,n_bumps=31,x_range=2.0,lambda=0.02,lr=9.6e-4,train_n=400, ep=20/max_train_s=1500). grad_clip is FREE -> same budget ~1630s under the 1800s kill. batch_size=2 (OOM guard); expandable_segments via --export.
